operating_notes.text: Enterprise revenue crossed ₹17,000 Cr across brands.
Domestic RevPAR grew 14% in Q1FY27, with Rajasthan and Goa up 27-29% and Mumbai, Delhi and Bangalore up 12-13%.
Portfolio stood at 645 hotels (382 operational, about 265 in the pipeline) and is expected to cross 650 in July 2026.
Ginger revenue was ₹183 Cr (+20% YoY, 39% EBITDA margin); Brij's 11 hotels did ₹11 Cr (+42%) and Atmantan ₹19 Cr (+19%).
IHCL portfolio reached 400 operational hotels in Q2FY27 with 670 total hotels including pipeline.
Gross cash reserves exceeded ₹4,350 Cr as of Q2 FY27.
Pipeline of over 34,800 keys is 94% capital-light (81% management contracts, 13% capital-light leases).
Taj Palace, New Delhi crossed ₹100 Cr in monthly revenue for the first time in September 2026.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹2,765.29 Cr (+14.0% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹599.86 Cr (+14.8% YoY).
The Indian Hotels Company reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹2,765 Cr, up 14% YoY, and full-year PAT of ₹2,084 Cr.
Melisa Alva, Senior Vice President & Company Secretary, shared the Q4-FY26 earnings call recording on May 11, 2026, via the company’s IR website.
The Indian Hotels Company reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹2,845 Cr, up 14% YoY, and FY26 PAT exceeding ₹2,000 Cr.

On its 21 July 2026 Q1FY27 earnings call, IHCL reported 15% revenue growth to ₹2,419 Cr and 21% PAT growth to ₹358 Cr, its 17th consecutive record quarter, and maintained double-digit FY27 revenue growth guidance.
2026-10-15: BMC imposes ₹0.10 Cr penalty on IHCL for missing NOC
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹2,484.32 Cr (+21.7% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹349.49 Cr (+22.7% YoY).
Melisa Alva, Senior Vice President & Company Secretary, shared the Q2 FY27 earnings call recording link on October 21, 2026.
IHCL upgraded its FY27 consolidated revenue growth guidance to 15-17% on Q2 revenue growth of 22% YoY.
